dependence_sensitivity.parameterization: log-scale boost lambda on the cells where the KABCO code and the narrative level imply the same severity position (O; C or B with BC-consistent; A or K with KA-consistent); the 'no cue' column never receives it. The factor is common to all latent classes, so it cancels from the per-rider class probabilities except through the other parameters.
